blocks.text: Proposal says prove AI is useful; available records are retrieval results for five room queries.
Narrow to relevant retrieval at a declared cutoff on those queries. The supplied records cannot answer universal usefulness or deployment impact.

independent_case.title: Apply a new case independently
independent_case.task: You have response times and correctness for two lookup procedures on ten fictional requests. Write a bounded question and one missing detail.
independent_case.answer: Teacher explanation: Ask whether B lowers latency while preserving correctness on those ten cases; specify timing boundary, matched inputs and scoring. No population-wide claim follows.
independent_case.source: primary source W4, first curriculum occurrence

misconceptions: The worked result establishes every future case
A measurable narrow question is not evidence of its answer.
A missing input may be replaced without recording the change
A replacement changes the evidence or contract. Record the change and its justification; do not silently turn unknown into a measured value.
Repeating an assessed case is new independent evidence
A replay checks consistency. An example used for feedback or revision cannot later be described as untouched final evaluation.
